scope: Selected 3D generation and scene/CAD workflow products; not an exhaustive global ranking

methodology.sort: descending visits_estimate for ranked records only
methodology.unit: visits per month; not unique visitors
methodology.precision: Expanded from rounded source values; integers do not imply exact measurement
methodology.coverage: As reported per domain; subdomain inclusion not independently established
methodology.limitation: Secondary estimates; no original Similarweb export. Meshy search-index result corroborated on Toolify. Rankings are popularity references, not quality benchmarks.
methodology.display_order: HeyDream is placed third and See3D fourth by user request; display_position is independent of traffic rank. Other ranked records retain descending traffic order.
